summary_markdown: The conversation revolves around technical debugging and updating the ClickHouse sandbox environment. Initially, an error occurred when attempting to run a configuration change (Code: 137), indicating that the 'max_memory_usage' setting was incorrectly placed at the top level of `config.xml` instead of within the `<profiles>` section in `users.xml`. A fix was pushed and deployed successfully later in the session. Later, someone requested a general update/refresh of the sandbox configuration.
decisions: The ClickHouse configuration error regarding 'max_memory_usage' placement was identified.
A fix for the configuration issue was pushed and deployed.
